label: Art, Literature & Architecture
officialText: Indian culture will cover the salient aspects of Art Forms, literature and Architecture from ancient to modern times.

label: Modern Indian History: Mid 18th Century
officialText: Modern Indian history from about the middle of the eighteenth century until the present- significant events, personalities, issues.

label: The Freedom Struggle
officialText: The Freedom Struggle — its various stages and important contributors/contributions from different parts of the country.

label: Post-independence Consolidation
officialText: Post-independence consolidation and reorganization within the country.

label: World History Events
officialText: History of the world will include events from 18th century such as industrial revolution, world wars, redrawal of national boundaries, colonization, decolonization, political philosophies like communism, capitalism, socialism etc.— their forms and effect on the society.

label: Salient features of Indian Society
officialText: Salient features of Indian Society, Diversity of India.

label: Women & Women's Organizations
officialText: Role of women and women’s organization, population and associated issues, poverty and developmental issues, urbanization, their problems and their remedies.

label: Effects of Globalization
officialText: Effects of globalization on Indian society.

label: Social Empowerment, Communalism, Regionalism & Secularism
officialText: Social empowerment, communalism, regionalism & secularism.

label: Physical Geography
officialText: Salient features of world’s physical geography.

label: Natural Resources
officialText: Distribution of key natural resources across the world (including South Asia and the Indian sub-continent); factors responsible for the location of primary, secondary, and tertiary sector industries in various parts of the world (including India).

label: Geophysical Phenomena
officialText: Important Geophysical phenomena such as earthquakes, Tsunami, Volcanic activity, cyclone etc., geographical features and their location-changes in critical geographical features (including water-bodies and ice-caps) and in flora and fauna and the effects of such changes.

label: Historical Underpinnings & Salient Features
officialText: Indian Constitution—historical underpinnings, evolution, features, amendments, significant provisions and basic structure.

label: Union & States: Functions & Challenges
officialText: Functions and responsibilities of the Union and the States, issues and challenges pertaining to the federal structure, devolution of powers and finances up to local levels and challenges therein.

label: Separation of Powers & Dispute Redressal
officialText: Separation of powers between various organs dispute redressal mechanisms and institutions.

label: Comparison of Indian Constitutional Scheme
officialText: Comparison of the Indian constitutional scheme with that of other countries.

label: Parliament & State Legislatures
officialText: Parliament and State legislatures—structure, functioning, conduct of business, powers & privileges and issues arising out of these.

label: Executive & Judiciary
officialText: Structure, organization and functioning of the Executive and the Judiciary—Ministries and Departments of the Government; pressure groups and formal/informal associations and their role in the Polity.

label: Representation of People's Act
officialText: Salient features of the Representation of People’s Act.

label: Constitutional Bodies
officialText: Appointment to various Constitutional posts, powers, functions and responsibilities of various Constitutional Bodies.

label: Statutory, Regulatory & Quasi-Judicial Bodies
officialText: Statutory, regulatory and various quasi-judicial bodies.

label: Government Policies & Interventions
officialText: Government policies and interventions for development in various sectors and issues arising out of their design and implementation.

label: Development Processes & NGOs
officialText: Development processes and the development industry —the role of NGOs, SHGs, various groups and associations, donors, charities, institutional and other stakeholders.

label: Welfare Schemes for Vulnerable Sections
officialText: Welfare schemes for vulnerable sections of the population by the Centre and States and the performance of these schemes; mechanisms, laws, institutions and Bodies constituted for the protection and betterment of these vulnerable sections.

label: Social Sector/Services (Health, Education, HR)
officialText: Issues relating to development and management of Social Sector/Services relating to Health, Education, Human Resources.

label: Poverty & Hunger
officialText: Issues relating to poverty and hunger.

label: Governance, Transparency & Accountability
officialText: Important aspects of governance, transparency and accountability, e-governance- applications, models, successes, limitations, and potential; citizens charters, transparency & accountability and institutional and other measures.

label: Role of Civil Services in Democracy
officialText: Role of civil services in a democracy.

label: India and its Neighborhood
officialText: India and its neighborhood- relations.

label: Bilateral, Regional and Global Groupings
officialText: Bilateral, regional and global groupings and agreements involving India and/or affecting India’s interests.

label: Effect of Policies of Developed & Developing Countries
officialText: Effect of policies and politics of developed and developing countries on India’s interests, Indian diaspora.

label: Important International Institutions
officialText: Important International institutions, agencies and fora - their structure, mandate.

label: Indian Economy & Planning
officialText: Indian Economy and issues relating to planning, mobilization, of resources, growth, development and employment.

label: Inclusive Growth
officialText: Inclusive growth and issues arising from it.

label: Government Budgeting
officialText: Government Budgeting.

label: Cropping Patterns & Irrigation
officialText: Major crops-cropping patterns in various parts of the country, - different types of irrigation and irrigation systems storage, transport and marketing of agricultural produce and issues and related constraints; e-technology in the aid of farmers.

label: Farm Subsidies & Food Security
officialText: Issues related to direct and indirect farm subsidies and minimum support prices; Public Distribution System- objectives, functioning, limitations, revamping; issues of buffer stocks and food security; Technology missions; economics of animal-rearing.

label: Food Processing & Supply Chain
officialText: Food processing and related industries in India- scope' and significance, location, upstream and downstream requirements, supply chain management.

label: Land Reforms
officialText: Land reforms in India.

label: Effects of Liberalization
officialText: Effects of liberalization on the economy, changes in industrial policy and their effects on industrial growth.

label: Infrastructure
officialText: Infrastructure: Energy, Ports, Roads, Airports, Railways etc.

label: Investment Models
officialText: Investment models.

label: Science & Technology: Developments
officialText: Science and Technology- developments and their applications and effects in everyday life.

label: Indigenization of Technology
officialText: Achievements of Indians in science & technology; indigenization of technology and developing new technology.

label: IT, Space, Computers, Robotics, Nano-tech
officialText: Awareness in the fields of IT, Space, Computers, robotics, nano-technology, bio-technology and issues relating to intellectual property rights.

label: Conservation, Pollution & Degradation
officialText: Conservation, environmental pollution and degradation, environmental impact assessment.

label: Disaster and Disaster Management
officialText: Disaster and disaster management.

label: Extremism and Development
officialText: Linkages between development and spread of extremism.

label: Internal Security Challenges & Actors
officialText: Role of external state and non-state actors in creating challenges to internal security.

label: Cyber Security, Media & Social Networking
officialText: Challenges to internal security through communication networks, role of media and social networking sites in internal security challenges, basics of cyber security; money-laundering and its prevention.

label: Border Management & Organized Crime
officialText: Security challenges and their management in border areas - linkages of organized crime with terrorism.

label: Security Forces and Agencies
officialText: Various Security forces and agencies and their mandate.

label: Ethics and Human Interface
officialText: Ethics and Human Interface: Essence, determinants and consequences of Ethics in-human actions; dimensions of ethics; ethics - in private and public relationships. Human Values - lessons from the lives and teachings of great leaders, reformers and administrators; role of family society and educational institutions in inculcating values.

label: Attitude
officialText: Attitude: content, structure, function; its influence and relation with thought and behaviour; moral and political attitudes; social influence and persuasion.

label: Aptitude and Foundational Values
officialText: Aptitude and foundational values for Civil Service, integrity, impartiality and non-partisanship, objectivity, dedication to public service, empathy, tolerance and compassion towards the weaker-sections.

label: Emotional Intelligence
officialText: Emotional intelligence-concepts, and their utilities and application in administration and governance.

label: Moral Thinkers and Philosophers
officialText: Contributions of moral thinkers and philosophers from India and world.

label: Public/Civil Service Values and Ethics
officialText: Public/Civil service values and Ethics in Public administration: Status and problems; ethical concerns and dilemmas in government and private institutions; laws, rules, regulations and conscience as sources of ethical guidance; accountability and ethical governance; strengthening of ethical and moral values in governance; ethical issues in international relations and funding; corporate governance.

label: Probity in Governance
officialText: Probity in Governance: Concept of public service; Philosophical basis of governance and probity; Information sharing and transparency in government, Right to Information, Codes of Ethics, Codes of Conduct, Citizen’s Charters, Work culture, Quality of service delivery, Utilization of public funds, challenges of corruption.

label: Case Studies on above issues
officialText: Case Studies on above issues.

label: Philosophy & Abstract Thought
officialText: Reflective, quote-based, and paradoxical statements testing wisdom, human condition, character, resilience, means vs ends.

label: Society & Social Justice
officialText: Gender parity, women empowerment, patriarchy, social inequalities, youth, social media dynamics, customary vs modern morality.

label: Polity & Governance
officialText: Constitutional morality, democracy, state effectiveness, people's participation, rule of law, classrooms shaping national destiny.

label: Economy & Development
officialText: Inclusive development, globalization, technology as enabler, sustainable subsistence, poverty, shared spaces vs conflicts.

label: Science, Tech & Environment
officialText: Technological outsourcing of self-discovery, cyberspace blessings/curse, alternative climate technologies, innovation determinants.

label: International Affairs & Geopolitics
officialText: Non-alignment relevance, multi-polar world, South Asian cooperation, global peace, international conflicts.

label: Culture, Education & Heritage
officialText: Classrooms shaping destiny, cultural identity, linguistic heritage, tourism potential, national synthesis.

label: Ethics & Values
officialText: Means and ends, moral courage, values vs behavior, power and responsibility, simplicity as sophistication.
